concept: Review and integration: agency as the foundation underneath every other Pillar
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across ownership within constraints, building something from nothing, and recovering from setbacks — how does agency show up in everything else you've learned so far?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real area of their life where they want to act with more agency starting now

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
